findings.text: follow-on: seven prototype modules import the private helper `_analytic_inputs` from the pytest file tests/equilibrium/test_topology_read.py, so the prototype tooling breaks if that test module is renamed or refactored and reaches into test internals rather than a supported seam.

follow-on: the headline map errors and walls in the lead paragraph are transcribed by hand from the job receipts with no assertion tying document text to receipt JSON, so a re-run or an edit can desync the document from its evidence without any gate turning red.

item_verdicts.diff: read the range commit by commit; 29 files, all prototype scripts under scripts/prototypes/lean_map plus the research doc, the evidence fragment and four figures, with no nova/ product module or tests/ path touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when asks for the research document at docs/research/fixed-shape-lean-map.html plus wall/error plots and one poloidal panel per topology and a clean audit-doc; the document is 115 lines with four committed SVGs under docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/lean-map, and I re-ran the named gate, `reckon audit-doc`, on both the research doc and the evidence fragment (both OK, exit 0).
item_verdicts.goal: the goal asks for a fixed-shape lean forward map prototype and the smallest cell count passing section 6; docs/research/fixed-shape-lean-map.html carries the values map, the bounded jet gather with a typed over-capacity refusal, exact cut booking and the solved ladder, and reports that no tested count passes joint 6 while naming 282/289 as the smallest map-accuracy-qualified rung.
item_verdicts.manifest: read manifest.md; it states status complete (as delivered it read blocked at manifest.md.asdelivered:5, a recognised value the coordinator repaired to complete per status-repair.json), names its measurement jobs and their EXIT lines, and leaves baseline_suite and after_suite empty because the done-when named no suite.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the four declared scopes are docs/research/fixed-shape-lean-map.html, scripts/prototypes/lean_map, docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/lean-map and docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/lean-map.html; git diff --name-only 6e65c31d..d8ff9b86a lists exactly 29 files and every one lies inside them.

justifications.durability: the delivered artifact is a research document with no runtime change, so no test regresses it; the probe asserts in scripts/prototypes/lean_map/probe_quadrature.py:109 guard a typed refusal but nothing pins the quoted headline numbers to their receipts.
justifications.evidence: values-1285577.log:10 records the 289-cell limited map error 1.4323e-4 and batch-checked-limited-250.json:47 the width-128 232.9 ms wall and 107/128 pass, both matching docs/research/fixed-shape-lean-map.html:52 and :96.
justifications.fit: scripts/prototypes/lean_map/render.py:25-30 draws through the committed nova.media.ink and nova.media.poloidal painters, the modules use mechanism names (LeanState, DenseValues, BookingStatus) with no plan label, and the range commits carry no attribution trailer.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the goal sentence is answered at docs/research/fixed-shape-lean-map.html:64, which names the 282/289 first rung as smallest map-qualified and states no tested count passes joint section 6.
justifications.reuse: scripts/prototypes/lean_map/forward.py:9 and probe_bias.py:25 extend nova.equilibrium.fixed_points, nova.equilibrium.current and nova.equilibrium.topology rather than forking them, and no production owner duplicates the prototype's bounded-refusal mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path of git diff --name-only 6e65c31d9fb1581de741c51cff6a77a593004989 d8ff9b86a76fdc16397e9a50d8cb2af903755872 is inside the four declared write paths and no product or test source changed.
